limitations: One direct-upstream focal fix corresponding to Defects4J Codec1 metadata; not a full framework reconstruction
Common fixed-tree partial fixture transplanted unchanged to both source revisions
DoubleMetaphoneTest omitted before execution: separately noticed aspell data and non-UTF8 source are incompatible with existing homogeneous-terms UTF8 producer
SoundexTest omitted before execution because original source is not UTF8; AllTests omitted because it references excluded classes
All other fixed-tree Java test files are retained with original LICENSE and NOTICE; no test-outcome selection
Same JVM and lexical test order; order independence has not been established
One curated fault affects several encoder classes; triggering methods and trials are not independent faults
Collection clocks are not CI history; elapsed counters are not runner-removable costs
Source integrity and reproduction do not grant scientific admission; preserve all negative and incomplete outcomes

Base64Test, HexTest and DigestUtilsTest use unseeded java.util.Random; generated input bytes and seeds are not captured. Fixed source bytes and saved observations replay, but fresh executions do not reconstruct identical generated inputs
